rows.note: Use this when a person deserves respect because of their character, achievements, or standing.

example.english: That teacher is a respectable person.
example.traditional: 嗰位老師係一個值得尊敬嘅人。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 lou5 si1 hai6 jat1 go3 zik6 dak1 zyun1 ging3 ge3 jan4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is decent, satisfactory, or reasonably good.

example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 sik6 m4 co3

rows.note: Use this for a person, appearance, or result that is presentable and socially respectable rather than merely satisfactory.

example.english: This report is finally respectable after the revisions.
example.traditional: 呢份報告改完之後，終於見得人喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 goi2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 zung1 jyu1 gin3 dak1 jan4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when saying that someone has a fair amount of money or assets and is moderately well-to-do.

example.english: After years in business, they now have a respectable amount of money.
example.traditional: 佢做生意多年，而家都算有啲身家。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 do1 nin4 ji4 gaa1 dou1 syun3 jau5 di1 san1 gaa1
